newsitem.title: USA: Optimax to buy assets from Madison.
newsitem.headline: Optimax to buy assets from Madison.

text.p: Optimax Industries Inc said Monday it has entered into a non-binding letter of intent to buy the assets of Madison Sports & Entertainment Inc.
The value of the deal was not disclosed.
Optimax said the acquisitions would allow it to issue shares of its common stock, the number of which will be finalized upon receipt of audited financial statements from Madison.
Optimax said 75 percent of the shares will be issued at closing of the deal, and the remaining balance will be issued upon the attainment of certain future financial results.
All shares issued in the deal will be distributed to Madison's shareholders as a dividend.
Optimax said it expects to close the deal in about 90 days.
Madison's assets include a giftware merchandising company an apparel manufacturing company.
Optimax said that the combined revenues, based on 1996 operating results, generated from the assets to be acquired amounted to about $5 million with a reported net loss of $303,000.
Optimax said it expects to integrate the acquired assets with existing giftware division.

The company also said it plans to begin a private placement of securities, which may consist of equity, debt or convertible debt, within the next 30 days to fund the working capital requirements of the deal, and it anticipates closing the private placement along with the acquisitions.
Optimax Industries is a manufacturing holding company with interest in the horticultural, giftware and specialty truck parts industries.
